title: V3 POSSIBILITY BOUNDARY / DIVERGENCE / V2 NONCONSUMPTION HOSTILE FEEDER

E01.finding: Eliminating the semantic V3 intake boundary either makes PSEPF own V3 runtime policy or leaves V3 field use without a typed decision/effective-time/use/metabolism applicability owner.

E02.finding: Copying PSEPF geometry into the wrapper creates duplicate empirical authority and stale-divergence risk; canonical intake remains reference-and-lifecycle oriented.

E03.finding: V3 intake applicability must be distinguished from upstream empirical field/comparator/source validity. Requery/recomputation and V3 re-binding are different operations; old fields remain immutable and replayable.

E04.target: R02-H08 comparator provenance plus R02-H10 negative-state intake
E04.finding: ActorComparatorReceipt remains provenance-only in V3. Upstream negative meanings stay at comparator/source/field owners; V3 intake preserves them and owns only V3-specific applicability denial/stale state. No fallback prior is authorized.

E05.finding: Same PSEPF and same ResolvedStructuralContext must remain compatible with divergent developed lives under different lawful V3 post-branch histories and explicitly governed randomness.

E06.finding: PSEPF/comparator/source disagreement/ResolvedStructuralContext cannot be directly dereferenced as persona/voice/belief authority. V2 may still render empirical or structural subject matter after V3 lawfully generates actor-accessible knowledge/belief.

wrapper_surviving_semantics: preservation/exposure of upstream typed negative state without semantic reownership
wrapper_forbidden_reownership: raw or weighted empirical support as second authority
empirical uncertainty semantics as second authority

V3_intake_boundary: intake unavailable for this V3 decision
negative_authority_split.rule: V3 may preserve upstream typed states but may not re-author their empirical meaning or invent fallback priors.

lifecycle_qualification.upstream_requery_triggers: owned by comparator/source/query/field authority and exact close-read rules
lifecycle_qualification.v3_rebind_triggers: may include V3 use class or metabolism-authority applicability changes without proving field recomputation is required

divergence_invariant: Equal PSEPF + equal ResolvedStructuralContext + equal relevant starting objective comparator facts do not imply equal later actor state; lawful post-branch V3 history/randomness may produce replayable divergence.

v2_app_boundary.qualification: Empirical or structural subject matter may be expressed after V3 lawfully generates actor-accessible knowledge/belief; direct upstream dereference remains forbidden.
